selection_policy: One deterministic screening pass over classes with >=60 photos: train-only nearest centroids of fixed nonlearned thumbnails; iteratively remove worst validation recall, ties mean nearest-other margin then category name, until20. All selected photos retained. No optical rho preference; no test pixels/scores used for screening. Split approx70/15/rest, capped100train/20val, previous train/val roles pinned. Freeze before optical training.
